tools.name: list_tenants
tools.description: Lists the organizations whose public governed knowledge GVE publishes, with the object types and counts each one exposes.

tools.name: list_objects
tools.description: Lists the public objects of one tenant. Without type: the tenant's object types and counts. With type: one page (100 per page) of that type's objects.

tools.name: get_object
tools.description: Returns one public governed object exactly as GVE serves it publicly, plus its governance view (provenance, validation, quality, last material change; freshness, confidence and relations are reported as not established or not published).

tools.name: search
tools.description: Lexical search over the labels and descriptions of the public objects. Returns identifiers to pass to fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetches the full public object for an id returned by search.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
